notes.title: Patch notes v.1.20
notes.notes:
[h2]UPDATE: July 14[/h2]
Dear Townscaper community,

We recently deployed an update which contained a number of optimization improvements that were developed while bringing Townscaper to additional platforms. Unfortunately, we've discovered some new issues caused by these changes and have temporarily reverted to an older version of the game.
We hope to get these issues patched soon so that we can deploy the optimization improvements once more.

On behalf of the team I'd like to apologize for these issues and ask for your patience as we get things sorted as soon as we can.

Thank you for your continued support for Townscaper, we really appreciate it.



---

Hi there, townscapers!

Here is a small little update that addresses a couple of issues that some of you have had:
[list]
[*] Screenshots turn out blank
[*] Parts of older towns don't fully render, such as having missing windows or no doves on top of the buildings
[/list]
If you notice anything strange while playing, don't hesitate to report it to the Raw Fury support desk: https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1


Happy building, folks!

notes.title: Patch notes v. 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Hi there, townscapers!

We have a smaller update available now that consists of the following:

- Performance optimization
- Some new props (you can now build a clock tower!)

We hope you will like it and feel free to post screenshots in the forum of all the cool towns you will create!

notes.title: Townscaper's new lighting update is absolutely gorgeous
notes.notes:
Procedural village-builder Townscaper was already a delight. A wonderfully tactile little tool for popping together quaint wee archipelagos with a look you could easily slap on a postcard. It’s frankly rude, then, that developer Oskar Stålberg has gone and made it even prettier in a new update, letting you move the sun itself to paint your perfect little seaside getaway.

(more…)
